title: Prologue
steps: Use Lucia’s conversation prompt in the cell, then accompany the guard.
Play through the flashback until control returns to the story.

title: Gone Fishing
steps: Collect the marked packages along the plane’s route.
Locate Donnie at the camp, then take the seaplane back to Brian’s Marina.

title: Gear Up
steps: Speak with Andrew inside the weapon shop. Choose a longarm in the shop menu to finish Jason’s equipment errand.

title: Lab Fees
steps: Find the clerk and complete the package pickup in the back room.
Use Jason’s phone to contact Brian and finish the delivery at his lockup.

title: Just a Scratch
steps: Bring Jason’s Ganado to Joey at Coastal Auto Care.
Select the engine repair and a paint finish in the garage menu.

title: Unwanted Attention
steps: Accompany Cal to Hamlet’s impound and look for the Imponte Phoenix.
Complete the vehicle markers and return to Brian’s garage for the payment.

title: Pipework
prerequisite: After Gear Up, Lab Fees, Just a Scratch, Unwanted Attention.
steps: Visit Mandy for the rent. At the sink, collect the plunger and complete the repair prompt.

title: Get Shirley’s Rum
prerequisite: After Gear Up, Lab Fees, Just a Scratch, Unwanted Attention.
steps: Ask the shop clerk about Shirley’s order and bring it home before Tourist Trap closes this errand.
notes: Time-sensitive. Make a separate save before advancing the story.

title: Steal the Scooter
steps: Return the marked scooter to Shirley and park it inside her house. Finish this before starting Tourist Trap.
notes: Time-sensitive. Make a separate save before advancing the story.

title: Hey Arnold!
steps: Follow Brian’s lead to the liquor shop, then continue to the radar station.
The last encounter offers a choice about Arnold’s fate.

title: Island Dreams
steps: Equip the dive gear and keep the group together through the trench.
At the wreck, follow the treasure signal and finish the rescue.

title: Feng Shui
area: Mariana County · Key Lento · Jason’s House
steps: Sit down with Cal, then use the prompts to rearrange the furniture.
Try both games on the new setup.

title: Pick up Groceries & Drop Off Groceries
steps: Purchase the groceries requested on Jason’s shopping list and return them to the house.

title: Buy Flowers
steps: Place a flower order for delivery to Lucia at home.

title: Buy Lucia a Necklace
steps: Visit The Siren’s Chest and choose a necklace for Lucia from its shop menu.

title: Get The Chop
steps: Visit Barnacle Beauties and confirm a haircut or beard change in the styling menu.

title: Get Lucia’s Clothes
steps: Find Andy at the Manatee’s Rest bar. Walk with her and collect Lucia’s belongings.

title: Coming Home
steps: Finish any homecoming errands you want to keep, then wait for the release call.
Collect Lucia from Hamlet Correctional.

title: Clean Up After Donnie
steps: Check the marked fishing spot in Hamlet for Donnie’s missing package.
Inspect what Jason finds and follow the delivery marker to Donnie’s trailer.

title: Buck Me
steps: Meet Lucia at the bank and talk to the manager.
Open BuckMe on the in-game phone and make the requested family savings transfer.

title: Down to Earth
prerequisite: After Clean Up After Donnie, Buck Me.
steps: Meet Brian at the marina and clean the boat with the prompted tool.
Take the aircraft to Bobcat Bay and complete the marked water landings.

title: Deposit Cash Into BuckMe
steps: Use the in-game index or BuckMe to locate an ATM, then deposit cash into checking.

title: Save for the Future
steps: Open Family Savings in BuckMe and transfer funds from checking. The Gold milestone is $100,000 in savings.

title: Find the Lost Drugs
steps: Follow the four separate search signals. Check the recreation area, burned houses, Pelican Valley and Thorpe Adventures.

title: Day Release
steps: Meet Kat and Mattia at the Rusty Anchor for the boat outing.
Finish the marked jetski race and follow Mattia during the evening sequence.

title: Clock Out
steps: Accept Lucia’s ride request when she calls. Reach her before 4 p.m. on the in-game clock.

title: Clear Skies
contact: Brian (via phone call), then Donnie in person
steps: Speak with Brian in Southwind and use the seaplane.
Meet Pete’s aircraft in the air and follow the escort route to the runway.

title: Building a Life
steps: At home, help Lucia assemble the coffee table and place its glass top when prompted.

title: Swamped
prerequisite: After Day Release, Clear Skies, Building a Life.
steps: Take Brian to the marked camp. Continue through the rescue sequence until you reunite with Lori.

title: Don Gone
steps: Find Donnie’s bag at the trailer and pack his belongings.
Use the mission car for the next sequence as Jason leaves Key Lento.
notes: The task activates after Swamped. Its first activity is at Donnie’s trailer.

title: Donnie’s Lost Drugs
area: Leonida Straits Ocean in north-east of Mariana County
steps: Dive near Donnie’s sunken boat off Corsair Key and collect the marked underwater item.

title: Recalibration
area: Mariana County · Key Lento · Jason’s House
steps: Buy something for Cal at the liquor shop, then visit his house.
Use the boat to reach the fishing marker and bring it back to Cal’s dock.

title: Tourist Trap
steps: Check the visitor centre locker for the bag.
Stay with your partner and complete the escape sequence after collecting it.

title: Home Sweet Home
area: Mariana County · Key Lento · Jason’s House
steps: At Jason’s house, pick up his marked personal stash before leaving with Lucia.

title: Discharge Time
steps: In Vice City Hospital, go upstairs to Jason’s room.
Complete the hospital and ambulance sequences to reach the chapter transition.

title: Search the Dive Sites
steps: Use the treasure icons Kenton marks after Island Dreams. Return completed sets at his shop and check his character-progress page for the next set.

title: Catch a Bigger Fish
steps: Take Cal’s fishing challenge in Gambit Bay. The target is a stoplight parrotfish weighing more than two pounds.

title: Search for the Skunk Ape
steps: Read a Skunk Ape flyer and find Kirk near Pelican Valley at night. Check the drone route and inspect the tree during the search.

title: Search for Tree Effigies
prerequisite: After Search for the Skunk Ape.
steps: Search Pelican Valley for three carved tree effigies and send Kirk the discoveries.

title: What’s in the Bag?
steps: Examine the note in the bag inside the Starlet Motel room.

title: Take Care of Jason
steps: Return to Jason’s motel room between errands and use the bedside interaction when he needs help.

title: Overnight Charges
steps: At the Starlet Motel desk, ask Linda how much the room costs.

title: Just Moved In
steps: Visit the nearby Alpha store for supplies requested by the motel objective.

title: Girl’s Trip
prerequisite: After Overnight Charges, Just Moved In.
steps: Ask the motel residents about Jason’s medication.
Check Vicki’s room and return to Jason before following the next prompt.

title: Pick Up A Gun
area: Kelly County · Port Gellhorn · Gellhorn Outfitters (Ammu-Nation Gun Shop)
steps: Use Gellhorn Outfitters’ shop menu or retrieve a previously owned weapon from its locker.

title: Moses
steps: Take a suitable car to Moses’s shop. Follow the Waink app tutorial and complete the in-game registration.

title: New Look
steps: Visit the clerk at Pearl House Hair Salon and select a new style for Lucia.

title: How Do I Look?
steps: Shop for both a top and trousers for Lucia. Bargain World is one option.

title: Painkiller Supplier
steps: Continue other available tasks until Dunk calls with news about Jason’s medication.

title: Ambulance Chaser
steps: Follow the lingering ambulance objective outside the motel and complete the game’s vehicle encounter.

title: Check Out McKittrick Farm
steps: Read Kyle’s flyer outside the motel, then visit McKittrick Farm.
Fly the marked crop-duster route and report back to Kyle after landing.

title: Behind on Payments
steps: Bring Linda $900 in game currency to settle the motel balance and recover the necklace.

title: Slam Dunk
area: Kelly County · Port Gellhorn · Dunk’s Trailer
steps: Visit Dunk’s trailer for the next lead, then follow his trip to the docks.
Complete Dr. Bill’s pickup and return with Dunk.

title: Collect Chemicals for Kyle
steps: Visit the warehouse Kyle marked and inspect the quest van.
Complete the in-game transaction or alternate encounter, then return the vehicle to Kyle.

title: Daily Driver
steps: Look for the 1982 Canis Crawler around the marked search area and return it to Moses.

title: Breakfast Run
steps: Check on Jason and head to Hank’s Waffles. Complete the linked venue objectives until the escape sequence ends.

title: Coffee Break
steps: Buy Lucia a coffee at the motel kitchen.
Outside, complete the tutorial for interacting with your partner.

title: Thrillbillies
steps: Use the mud club’s merchandise stall and vehicle rental.
Register with the race organizer and beat Billy’s crew member.

title: Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab
steps: Meet Billy’s crew and ride the marked dirt-bike route. Follow Billy through the crash-site encounter.

title: Hit Avery Pawn
steps: Bring your partner to Avery Pawn and complete the shop’s activity objectives.
Follow the escape and fence prompts to finish the outing.

title: Hit Kingpin Bowling
steps: Start the bowling-alley activity with your partner. Check the venue’s objectives before leaving if you are also tracking its watch or trophy.

title: Impounded Vehicle
steps: Recover Lucia’s personal car from the marked impound in Port Gellhorn.

title: Prepare for Vice City
area: Kelly County · Coffee room of Starlet Motel
steps: Partner up and earn at least $15,000 while Dre’Quan works on housing. Check the cash total before moving on.

title: Veteran Hunted
prerequisite: After Coffee Break, while working toward the cash target for Prepare for Vice City.
steps: Join Bret for the hunting tutorial.
Use the tracking and wildlife-study prompts before completing the marked return.

title: Afternoon Delight
steps: Meet Vicki at Delights. Get backstage, watch the performance and follow the safe objective before leaving.

title: Checking Out
steps: Regroup at the motel when you are ready to move. Stay with your partner through the departure sequence.

title: Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove
steps: Return to Kirk near Cottonmouth Lake as Lucia at night. Follow the search and choose how to resolve the final encounter.
notes: Kirk’s strand can begin in Chapter 1. This step requires Lucia and nightfall.

title: Steal Vehicles for Moses
steps: Use Moses’s requested-vehicle list to identify the current model. Return each matching vehicle to his auto shop.

title: Collect Moses’ Gift
steps: Once Moses offers his reward, head back to the auto shop in Port Gellhorn to claim it.

title: Bret’s Hunting Decks
steps: Open the hunting decks after meeting Bret. Work through the 15 assignments, starting with the deck titled Adrenal Glands and Venison.

title: Welcome to Vice City
steps: Meet Dre’Quan inside Jack of Hearts and finish the club interactions.
Follow the apartment marker to see your new place.

title: Dealer’s Choice
steps: Join Dre’Quan and make the product selection offered by the mission.
Complete the meeting and take him to Southside.

title: Dubious Provenance
area: Vice City · Bayside (Part 1), Mariana County · Capri (Parts 2 & 3)
steps: Visit the antique dealer in Capri to identify the statue.
Consult the optional Halifax phone objective before deciding what to do with it.

title: Mami Knows Best
steps: Meet Mia and help clear the property she is visiting.
Follow her through the encounter that interrupts the house tour.

title: Get Your Wheels
steps: Register a vehicle at a Pay ’n’ Spray or recover an impounded car to establish a ride in Vice City.

title: Join a Street Race
steps: Pick a vehicle at the Salton race marker and finish the street circuit.

title: Here, Kitty Kitty
steps: Look for Charles at his apartment before checking the La Perle camp. Follow the character marker when it moves.

title: Send Money to Lorena
steps: Use the in-game BuckMe transfer to send money to Lucia’s aunt Lorena.

title: Encrypted Hard Drive
steps: Continue the available story errands while waiting for Brian’s call about the encrypted drive.

title: Boobie Time
steps: Drive Boobie between the marked stops and rejoin him after visiting the club. The route introduces another contact at the smoke shop.

title: Buddy?
steps: Read Kyle’s message and return to his farm. The encounter branches according to whom you approach.

title: Meet the Heders
steps: Meet Brian and Lori at the restaurant, then continue to the dockyard. Look for the marked Scoop container during the search.

title: Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs
steps: Use Yasmani’s task list for the three named jewelry venues. Return the requested in-game valuables to him.
actionLabel: Hit Richardson Jewelry, Hit Donovan Banks & Co, Hit Casa de Empeno, Sell Jewelry to Yasmani
notes: PowerPyx includes this in the Chapter 3 story sequence and Yasmani’s side strand. GTA Base lists it as optional.

title: Bumper to Bumper
steps: Visit Yago at his restaurant, then fit the requested upgrades in the mod shop.
Follow Yago to the race and finish the course.

title: Car Service
steps: Find the Schafter V12 in the marked search area and bring it to Leonida Auto World for Raul.

title: Send More Money to Lorena
steps: Send Lorena her follow-up payment from the BuckMe app.

title: Top Billing
steps: Join Dre’Quan backstage, meet the Real Dimez and follow Roxy through the evening’s stops.

title: First Impressions
steps: Meet Raul on Waxman Island and stay with the route as the vehicle changes. Deliver him to the final marker.

title: Crosstown Traffic
area: Lucia – Vice City · Stockyard / Jason – Vice City · La Perle
steps: Choose a start for the current character. Lucia’s marker is in Stockyard and Jason’s is in La Perle.
Follow the river and metro objectives as the viewpoints change.

title: Credit Check
steps: Visit Raul’s planning room and speak with Andrea and Karim. Follow the crew’s outfit and bank-sequence prompts.

title: Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS
steps: Locate the Zorrusso requested by Randy in Ocean Beach and deliver it to him. This introduces his vehicle list.

title: Ride Or Die
steps: Visit the Eris store with Dre’Quan and find the DWNPLY shoes. Take them to the marked VIP encounter.

title: Raul’s Next Job
steps: Continue available tasks until Raul calls about his next job.

title: Race Against Yago
steps: Join Yago’s race while the time-sensitive invitation is active and follow the course to the finish.
notes: Time-sensitive. Make a separate save before advancing the story.

title: Sinfrontera National Bank
steps: Visit Sinfrontera National Bank with the crew. Follow the in-game survey prompts before regrouping with Raul.

title: Security Expert
steps: Locate Nicole in Waning Sands, then escort her through the encounter to the planning room.

title: Caught Slipping
steps: Investigate the incident at the apartment. Check the quest bag and continue with Jason to Big House Storage.

title: Heist Planning
steps: Open the heist plan and complete its outstanding preparation missions.

title: Company Property
steps: Meet Brian in Hamlet and follow the mission to the airfield. Bring the marked delivery back to the planning room.

title: Safe Word
steps: Travel to Gil’s mansion and play through the poolside sequence. Complete Nicole’s practice objective when it appears.

title: The Missing Link
steps: Meet Andrea in Watson Bay and stay with her through the marked rendezvous. Rejoin Lucia when the viewpoint changes.

title: Mall Rats
steps: Meet Billy behind the Malibu in Ocean Beach while playing solo. Follow his crew through the shop and back to the van.

title: Brother To Brother
steps: Find Yago at the restaurant and accompany him and Manuel to the meeting. Follow the character markers through its aftermath.

title: Cooties
steps: Join Dre’Quan and the Dimez for the music-video shoot. Finish the car sequence and return to the studio.

title: Hidden Charges
steps: Start at the planning room. Complete Karim’s marked preparation objectives and return to the crew.
actionLabel: Meet at the Planning Room / Prepping the Explosives

title: Bricked Up
steps: Visit Venture Apartments and ask for Raymond in the lobby. Regroup with your partner to finish the escape.

title: South Leonida Real Estate
steps: Check Mia’s property in Hamlet and search for her at the mission markers. Stay with her through the later property visits.

title: The Cartel Heist
steps: Start the prepared mission with Raul’s crew. Follow the character-switch and signal prompts during the bank sequence.
actionLabel: Start the Heist / Wait for Raul to get in Touch

title: The Impaler
steps: Find the marked Police Impaler in Ambrosia. Take it to Billy’s designated tunnel drop-off to finish the assignment.

title: Hometown Heroes
steps: Rejoin Billy at the mud club and follow his raceway route. Stay with the crew through the job’s closing sequence.

title: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3)
steps: Visit Andy at her new place in Belville. Open the essentials kit and complete the successive product deliveries.

title: Pay the Cellerica Fee
steps: Use the transfer requested in Andy’s phone message to pay the Cellerica initiation fee through BuckMe.

title: Peach!
steps: Join Andy at the Cellerica campus. Use the changing-room prompt, finish the initiation and continue to Cecilia’s mansion.

title: Read the Label
steps: Recover the Cellerica quest van and take it to the assigned warehouse.

title: Puff Puff Pass
area: Paper Boys warehouse (meeting) · Cecilia’s Mansion (later objective)
steps: Meet the group at the Paper Boys warehouse. Follow Felix, leave the warehouse sequence and find Cecilia at her mansion.

title: Yasmani’s ATM Jobs
steps: Check Yasmani’s unlocked ATM assignments under the robbery activities and complete the requested game objectives.

title: Yasmani’s Payday Loans Jobs
steps: Select the payday-loan activities offered by Yasmani and finish the locations requested for his strand.

title: Tail the Security Van
steps: Use Yasmani’s security-van tip to start the marked vehicle encounter. Complete the route given by the game.

title: Randy’s Wish List
steps: Check Randy’s vehicle requests in the robbery menu. Use the Waink app to identify a matching model and bring it to the marked delivery point.

title: Take Out Kitty Litter
prerequisite: Meet Tyrone in Here, Kitty Kitty.
steps: Continue Tyrone’s lab objectives and track completed locations. His final quest becomes available after enough marked labs are cleared.

title: Spin On This
steps: Meet Tyrone for the final synthetic-lab assignment in Grayson. Follow the motel search markers and finish the game’s lab encounter.

title: Dunk’s Robbery Tips
steps: In Chapter 3, look under Robberies on the in-game map for Dunk’s purple tip markers. Each tip points to a separate activity.

title: Ocean Beach
steps: Check in with Valentina at the Y Hotel. Take the lift to floor seven and explore suite 701 with Lucia.

title: Another Life
steps: Answer the phone in Lucia’s flashback. Use the care prompts with Tomás and follow the radio and dance sequence.

title: Pool Day
steps: Pick up Lucia’s cocktail at the pool bar. Return to her and follow the walk prompt.

title: Company Cars
steps: Speak with the salesman and pick a car for each protagonist.
Follow Lucia in the race back to the Y Hotel.

title: Lawyer Up
steps: Check in with Sandy, then meet Abe Gonzalez for the consultation.

title: Heavy Lifting
steps: Bring the drive to Raul. Follow the houseboat and gym objectives to meet the staff at Ajax Gym.

title: It’s A Date!
steps: Order a drink at the Courtyard Bar in Stockyard during the date activity.

title: Party Hard
steps: Accompany Andrés through his order pickup and Megamundo visit. Use the radio and protection prompts when the job changes.

title: Pay Abe’s Fee
steps: Pay the $75,000 legal fee shown by the Chapter 4 task to advance Abe’s identity paperwork.
notes: The walkthrough index lists this title in Chapters 4 and 5.

title: Photo/Shoot
steps: Photograph the Dimez at the marked shoot. Follow the vehicle sequence when Dre’Quan needs help.

title: Bad Driver!
steps: Search Millport for Felipe and follow his marker to the resolution of Andrea’s tip.

title: Attend Eddie Acosta’s Party
area: Vice City · Ocean Beach · Y Hotel
steps: Go solo to the party appointment. Meet Eddie at the lift to continue to the event.

title: Making Gainz
steps: Find Nate in the workout area and use the exercise stations alongside him. Regroup with Jason before returning to planning.

title: Blood Sweat and Gear
steps: Visit the Trauma Floor at Ajax Gym. Use the locker, talk to Nate and complete the crew workout.

title: Too Much Baggage
steps: Report to Omar at the airport and follow the baggage-handling tutorial. Bring the marked bags to the loading bay.

title: Watch It
steps: Meet Dre’Quan and visit the Cruda car park with him. Continue to the appointments leading to the club-owner meeting.

title: Amateur Hour
steps: Change at the gym locker and join Cisco’s outing. Stay with his vehicle and meeting objectives.

title: Call Nate
steps: As Lucia, answer Nate’s text after Amateur Hour by calling him. The guide also reports that he can ring after about an in-game day.

title: Cash Injections
steps: Join Nate in Ocean Beach and ride with him to the meeting. Recover the marked car before leaving the area.

title: Dirty Work
prerequisite: After Too Much Baggage, Cash Injections.
steps: Visit the Velvet Palm Motel and complete the mission’s photo objective. Check back with your partner and meet Nate by the pool.

title: Nate Will Be in Touch
steps: Wait for Nate’s message about Kordell’s crew and use its mission prompt when it appears.

title: Adventures in Babysitting
steps: Accompany Andrés to The Vault. Use the bar, photo and conversation prompts while on security duty.

title: Rafa’s Kidnapping
steps: Look for Jason’s Chapter 4 task under this title in the in-game mission list.

title: Fresh Evidence
prerequisite: After Watch It, Adventures in Babysitting.
steps: Accompany Dre’Quan to Starfish Island. Follow his search through the mansion for the requested evidence.

title: Child’s Play
steps: Travel to the quarry and use the game’s binocular prompt to find Rafa. Complete the partner switch during the rescue.

title: This is a Free Call From…
steps: Accept Shayna’s time-sensitive release task as Lucia. Give her a ride and finish the meeting at Raph’s house.
notes: Time-sensitive. Make a separate save before advancing the story.

title: Power Play
steps: Ask about Kordell at reception. Work through the two protagonists’ objectives until the planning-room sequence resolves.

title: Close Surveillance
steps: Meet Karim as Jason and use the mission drone. Follow the on-screen objectives from the rooftop bar to apartment 405.

title: Delivery Method
steps: Take Andrea’s assignment as Jason. Follow the delivery role to TSS and use the mission interaction at the marked office computer.

title: Team Building
steps: Take Kordell to see Arlo. Finish the arena challenge and continue with Kordell to Riverbank in Little Cuba.

title: Fully Catered
steps: Deliver the Plane & Simple quest truck. At Raul’s base, use Jason’s packing prompts to finish the preparation.

title: Heist Plans in Place
steps: Check the VCIA preparation list for the objective showing that the heist plans are in place.

title: Headliners
steps: Run the light show from Lucia’s DJ station during the reopening. Switch to Jason for Royce’s guest list and VIP tables.

title: VCIA Takedown
steps: Start the prepared airport job. Follow Lucia’s vault sequence and Jason’s baggage assignment as the game switches viewpoints.

title: Tie Up Loose Ends
steps: Keep playing during the wait for Raul. Answer the other incoming call and return it to continue the story.

title: That’s Where The Money Is…
steps: Wait at Cafe Orquidea for Yasmani’s optional security-van encounter. Follow its mission markers through the bank sequence.

title: Call Valentina Back
steps: Use Valentina’s contact to return the call during the transition into Sunset.

title: Sunset
steps: Talk with Valentina and pick up the note. Search the marina for Raul, then finish the boat sequence with Lucia.

title: Starting From Zero
steps: Look for Andrea in the Aqua Stadium stands and collect the statue from Big House Storage.
Ride the lift to the terrace at Acai Dreams for Mattia’s meeting.

title: The Last Mile: Passing the Torch
steps: Visit Sundown Private Airfield and check the hangar for Pete’s stash. Use his aircraft for the marked deliveries, then bring it back.

title: The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot
prerequisite: After The Last Mile: Passing the Torch.
steps: Report to Wild Hog Airfield. Use the aircraft to reach the supplier and the marked buyers.

title: Pete’s Deliveries: Southpoint Airfield
prerequisite: Finish The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot and wait for Pete to get in touch.
steps: Choose the Southpoint Airfield assignment from Pete’s delivery list and fly its marked supply and drop-off route.

title: Pete’s Deliveries: Avery Allen & Co.
prerequisite: Finish The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot and wait for Pete to get in touch.
steps: Choose the Avery Allen & Co. assignment for Pete. Complete the supplier landing and buyer markers for that run.

title: Deliver Packages
prerequisite: Finish The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot and wait for Pete to get in touch.
steps: Follow the delivery run that Pete assigns after the named airfield jobs. Use its current supplier and buyer markers.

title: Bird in the Hand
steps: Join Gallo’s training sequence. Use the assigned aircraft and switch between Jason and Lucia during the cargo-helicopter encounter.

title: Taking Liberties
steps: At Gallo’s penthouse, look for the spa on the gym floor. Walk there with your partner for Giorgio’s meeting.

title: Doggie Bag
steps: Check in with Vinny, then search the cruise ship’s top deck for Rocco as Lucia. Follow the retrieval prompt to the marked pickup.

title: VC Baby
steps: Follow Mattia after Kat goes into labour. The game lets you decline his request or accept the extra trip to the hospital.

title: Operation Savage Glory
steps: Join Vinny’s crew and follow the alternating protagonist objectives. Finish the cargo pickup and helicopter sequence.

title: Honest Abe
steps: Leave Gallo’s penthouse for Abe’s office. Before signing later, check BuckMe and transfer any checking balance you want to retain into Family Savings.

title: Unfinished Business
steps: Meet Abe, then play through the penthouse conversation and Lucia’s pool-table sequence. Watch the security feed with Giorgio and follow the subsequent story prompts.

title: Pay Abe’s Fee
steps: Check Abe’s fee entry in your current chapter. The index also lists an earlier payment under the same name.
notes: The walkthrough index lists this title in Chapters 4 and 5.

title: Protective Custody
steps: Make a separate save before confirming the finale prompt.
Complete Jason’s rescue and choose a response to Méndez when the game offers it.
notes: This mission includes an ending choice.

title: The End of the Road
steps: Start at Cal’s place in the Keys. Follow the high-rise and airfield objectives through to the choice on the bridge.
notes: This mission includes an ending choice.
